messages:
alex_sales: Quick kickoff for Catalysts Inc eval — need to align success criteria, data access, redaction, storage, connectivity, and pricing asks. Can we map owners and timeline? (ETA 2 weeks for eval)

maria_se: I can take lead on prompts + evals. What's the sample shape? rows, avg doc length?

alex_sales: They said 5k docs, avg 3-4 pages each (OCR'd). Must not leave PII. Also want interactive chat + batch embedding runs.

maria_se: OK — will prepare 10 prompt templates and an eval set (100 queries). Need sample data in S3 or we can supply synthetic redacted set. Which does Catalysts prefer?

jamie_solutions: Security flagged they'd rather provide a locked S3 bucket we read via role assumption (no egress). Also they asked about KMS & audit logs.

eve_security: To support that: we need IAM role with read-only, SSE-KMS for S3 objects, and request they enable object-level logging (CloudTrail). We'll need completed security questionnaire v2.

chris_infra: Provisioning note: we can create a one-off sandbox in us-west-2. ETA 48h after creds. We support S3 + SFTP mount. For role assumption, provide ARN and we add trust policy.

alex_sales: @chris_infra timeline sounds good. Catalysts also asked about private deployment option (VPC peering). Is that in-scope for this eval?

chris_infra: VPC peering is heavier. For a 2-week eval I'd recommend S3 role + signed URL ingestion. VPC would add 2-3 weeks and an ent. access review.

jamie_solutions: Pricing ask: they're requesting per-token estimate and a short burst cap. I'll send a provisional pricing note: hosted eval credits + estimated dedicated-hour cap. @alex_sales can you confirm budget?

alex_sales: Budget: they'd approved up to $7k of credits for the PoC plus potential dedicated reserve if results look good.

maria_se: Redaction rules proposal:
```yaml
redact_fields:
  - ssn
  - dob
  - credit_card
  - email
  - phone
prefix_preserve: false
redaction_mode: mask
```
We can run a quick redaction pass and return a synthetic sample.

eve_security: Also add named-entity suppression for patient names and account IDs. Need a signed DPA before we touch real PII.

alex_sales: Good call. We'll push for a copy of their DPA today.

jamie_solutions: For success criteria suggest:
- 1) Retrieval accuracy: top-3 precision >= 78% on the eval set
- 2) Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for chat (streaming ok)
- 3) Cost: per-1k-token cost < $X (TBD after model choice)
- 4) Security: audit logs + KMS in place before ingestion
Is that acceptable?

maria_se: I like it. I'll craft the eval harness and share prompt templates. Need a small labeled set (50 Q/A) to compute precision.

chris_infra: Quick creds checklist we need from Catalysts:
- S3 bucket name + region
- IAM role ARN with read-only
- List of files (prefix)
- Point of contact for certs/network
Once we have that we can spin up the env.

alex_sales: I'll ask for those items in my email today. Also flagging one enterprise blocker: Catalysts legal needs a custom indemnity clause — might need legal review.

eve_security: If legal needs custom terms, that'll push timeline. @alex_sales capture their contract contact and we'll triage.

deploy_bot: sandbox-provisioner: environment request queued (sales-1752001234). Expected ready time: 2025-05-18T14:00:00Z :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

alex_sales: Great. Next steps: (1) I'll request S3 creds + DPA + contract contact, (2) @maria_se will prepare prompt/eval templates, (3) @chris_infra to provision once creds arrive, (4) @jamie_solutions to send provisional pricing. Check-in Friday 10am PT?

maria_se: Works for me :thumbsup:

jamie_solutions: Works

chris_infra: +1

eve_security: I'll start the security questionnaire and list required fields.

alex_sales: Thanks all — I'll follow up with Catalysts and post updates in this thread.
